question: What does the Runloop signup at https://platform.runloop.ai/auth/register require beyond the account creation named in the quickstart?
why: the signup page at platform.runloop.ai/auth/login answers 503 DEPLOYMENT_PAUSED on a direct read and on every provider pin that returned content (jina-keyless, browserless, cfbr, hyperbrowser); cfscan, crawl4ai, diffbot and flovia returned broker 502/504 and tinyfish a 422; the pricing page states no credit card is required but no first-party signup field list was readable
